plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade poison scaling and strong block. Preserve a defensive potion and sufficient HP to survive the explosion after killing the boss.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then establish poison scaling and dexterity-backed block. Spend potions to secure worthwhile elites without exhausting HP. Remove Strikes as better damage arrives; prepare separately for the boss explosion.
